hypotheses:
Every judge question gets asked and answered, always through a question tool. A session plumb runs headless, such as the benchmark's, is given a stand-in question tool that its scripted owner answers (DEC-407), and the owner's typed answer to a question that was asked settles it. plumb never lets a missing tool silence a question. The agent verifies the other two held fixes itself: the log path filter belongs in the log module (DEC-195).
will: plumb evaluate gives its headless agent a stand-in question tool that the scripted owner answers
will: a typed answer to a judge question that was asked counts as answering it, even when the record was not shown in the last reply
will: the benchmark's headless agent no longer inherits the launching session's attended flag
will: the landing job asks the log module which log paths a commit may name
won't: turn the question gate off because a ToolSearch did not find the question tool
won't: tell the owner only that the work waits, leaving the questions unasked
